exposure: gestational age at or before 32 weeks
cohort: This study enrolled 21,576 children born at < 37 weeks of gestation, with 3,596 having hearing loss and 17,980 with normal hearing, born between 2002 and 2015, matched for sex, age at diagnosis, and enrollment time.
finding: Maternal HL, maternal diabetes, and premature birth at or before 32 weeks were major obstetric risk factors, while ear malformation, seizure, ototoxic drug use, and multiple diagnoses of conditions like BPD, NEC, and ICH were significant postnatal risk factors for hearing loss in prematurely born children.
mod_finding: Prematurely born children delivered via cesarean section who also received a combination of antenatal steroids and magnesium sulfate exhibited a significantly reduced risk of developing hearing loss.
country: N/A (nationwide implies within a single country, but not specified)
followup_time: N/A (data abstracted until diagnosis of HL, but not a fixed follow-up period from birth)
